Proposition
[Busemann comparison along an asymptote]

Source: petersen:page-0317, petersen:page-0318 ↗ def:pet-ch7-horosphere-asymptote 1. ch7:7.3.8With $c,p,\tilde c$ as in item 3, the Busemann functions satisfy

  1. $b_c(x)\le b_c(p)+b_{\tilde c}(x)$ for all $x\in M$;

  2. $b_c(\tilde c(t))=b_c(p)+b_{\tilde c}(\tilde c(t))=b_c(p)-t$ for all $t\ge 0$.

Proof

↗ prop:pet-ch7-busemann-asymptote-relation \sketch For segments $\sigma _i$ from $p$ to $c(t_i)$ converging to an asymptote $\widetilde c$, split their lengths and use item 3 to obtain $b_c(\widetilde c(s))=b_c(p)-s$. Applying the triangle inequality through $\widetilde c(t)$ and then letting $t\to \infty $ gives $b_c(x)\le b_c(p)+b_{\widetilde c}(x)$.

□
